action_items: Optional cleanup: created a warranty document during test — Akt №6626154 (doc id CgVdxZOJz8Q0llX0qiCV) under user 5aC46xfnJ0OtpvrZ38BVVvwR6GC3. Consider deleting from Firestore 'warranty_services' collection if unwanted.
critical_code_review_comments: warrantyService.subscribeMyWarrantyServices uses a where('userId','==',uid) query without an orderBy — fine currently, sorting is done client-side, so no composite index needed.
InlineSignaturePad MIN_STROKES_REQUIRED=8 works but note: if user draws a very short signature it won't be captured — UX ambiguity (no feedback). Consider showing 'İmza qəbul edildi' after threshold.
WarrantyServicePage reads userName/userSurname/userPhone from localStorage once at render (not reactive). Not a bug for this flow, but if user updates profile it won't reflect until a full reload.
genServiceNumber() uses last 8 digits of Date.now() — theoretical collision possible under high concurrency; consider Firestore auto ID or a counter doc.
